extraction_notes: The electrical-characteristics table is headed TA = 25 degC. Typical-characteristic figures do not uniformly state temperature; curve conditions are asserted only where shown or inherited from the dynamic table.

This is a P-channel device. Signed negative values from the electrical table are preserved in specs. The typical curves plot positive magnitudes, so their axes and conditions explicitly use |VDS|, |VGS|, and |ID|.
No typical gate-source threshold voltage is published. The threshold figure on p. 5 is a temperature-variation plot, not a single typical table value.
The dynamic-capacitance condition is a merged table cell applying VDS = -20 V, VGS = 0 V, and f = 1 MHz to Ciss, Coss, and Crss.
The VSD table row publishes TYP = -0.8 V and MAX = -1.25 V at IS = -1.25 A; body_diode records the typical value.
Curve points are manual digitizations of plotted traces on p. 4 and are not substituted table values.
